events.description: Fireman No. 1 says Fireman No. 3, Fireman No. 2, and Fireman No. 1 have got some items there and are determining what they are.
Fireman No. 2 says one of the items looks like a half-charred picture.
Fireman No. 2 says Man 1 is hairier than the Fire Chief.
Monica Geller says Fireman No. 3, Fireman No. 2, and Fireman No. 1 know.
Monica Geller says the story of how the current fire happened is really funny.
Monica Geller says the current fire situation occurred.
Fireman No. 3 says the current fire situation is all right.
Fireman No. 3 says Monica Geller does not need to explain how the fire happened.
Fireman No. 3 says this boyfriend bonfire is not the first such boyfriend bonfire they have encountered.
Fireman No. 3 says Fireman No. 3, Fireman No. 2, and Fireman No. 1 have seen boyfriend bonfires like this before.
Fireman No. 3 says those boyfriend bonfires got out of control.
Fireman No. 1 says Monica Geller, Rachel Green, and Phoebe Buffay are Fireman No. 3, Fireman No. 2, and Fireman No. 1's third call tonight.
Fireman No. 2 says Valentine's Day is the busiest night of the year for Fireman No. 3, Fireman No. 2, and Fireman No. 1.
